input: PsSpecializedIrModule, freshly strictly revalidated; no external imports
selection: Explicit source declaration / foreign function names, 1..1024 exports; foreign names and uniqueness validated by InterfaceIR; parameter labels are positional arg0..arg15.
supported: Synchronous bool/char, fixed-width signed/unsigned integers, f32/f64, usize/isize resolved from the actual target word profile; zero-result Unit returns.
rejected: Unit parameters; Nat/Int/String/aggregate/function/unknown/generic values at the export boundary; polymorphic selected declarations; more than 16 arguments; imports, resources, async.

output.binary: Actual lowered Wasm with only selected foreign export names
output.interfaceJson: psc-interface-ir-json/1 derived from actual source declarations
output.bindingJson: Contract, runtime semantics, wordBits, interfaceName, and functionName/coreExport/sourceName bindings
output.target: Exact validated PsWasmModule used for binary encoding, retained for the driver's canonical WasmIR snapshot

invariants: No source signature supplied by the host substitutes for actual revalidated IR declarations.
Source parameter order and primitive semantics are retained; source parameter spelling is not assumed to be a legal WIT name.
The independent Canonical ABI planner determines expected core signatures; the actual target functions reached by exports are checked against those signatures.
Structural and operand/control WasmIR validation runs on the exact module subsequently encoded.
Only explicitly selected exports are externally visible; internal GC/runtime helpers retain their private representation.
The scalar profile uses no linear memory; wordBits describes source machine words and does not imply memory64.
Unit results already lower to zero core results. Unsupported representations require future conversion wrappers, never silent reinterpretation.
Artifacts are data, not CheckedCore/CertifiedSource authority or a preservation theorem.
hostConsumer: scripts/canonical-exports.mjs with consumer-pinned exact interface/binary identities and bindings projected to functionName/coreExport.

validation.portable: PSC1-portable-selfhost/1 structural audit and explicit PSC1 source check in check:foreign-interface

precedingCloud.focusedStep: Check portable foreign interfaces and WIT boundary
precedingCloud.conclusion: success; full run tail cancelled by concurrent docs update

remaining: Production checked-driver/API/CLI selection routing and EvidenceEnvelope/output publication; build graph and offline relations are implemented
Global source/backend/adapter preservation proof or independently validated relation

hostEvidence.projection: Independent bounded reconstruction of InterfaceIR and binding JSON from exact SpecializedIR and export-selection bytes
hostEvidence.binary: Closed exact export surface, numeric core signatures, and optional WasmIR source-name/function-index routing; engine validation without instantiation
hostEvidence.graph: checked-build-evidence.mjs records selection, interface, binding, target IR, binary and signature-validation artifacts
hostEvidence.offline: observed-build-archive.mjs repeats projection and signature checks from consumer-pinned archived graph bytes
hostEvidence.scope: Signature projection and target acceptance only; strict body invariants, source authority and behavioral preservation remain separate.
